name: swarmgpt
description: Fan work out to parallel `codex exec` sessions with per-subtask model routing, on-disk run logs, and image generation.

interface.shortDescription: Parallel codex exec swarms with run logs
interface.longDescription: Decompose a task into independently owned subtasks, route each to gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-sol or gpt-6-luna by difficulty, dispatch them as concurrent codex exec sessions, and keep an auditable run log. Note: an interactive Codex session already has native multi-agent support — this plugin adds per-subtask model routing and on-disk logs on top of it.
defaultPrompt: Use codex-swarm to parallelize this task.
Use codex-imagegen to generate these image assets.
